# Tat Khalsa Puratan Jantri (ਤੱਤਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਜੰਤਰੀ)

> Authentic Sikh Puratan Bikrami Sambat luni-solar calendar published by Tatkhalsa Foundation with Sambat 2082-2084+ perpetual astronomical coverage (2025-2035+ CE) anchored to Sri Anandpur Sahib (IST) Udaya Sangrands.

## Methodology & Chronology
- **Traditional Puratan Bikrami Luni-Solar Reckoning**: Follows traditional Puratan Sikh Jantri chronology rather than the 2003 solar-fixed Nanakshahi calendar.
- **Sri Anandpur Sahib (IST) Udaya Sangrands**: Solar month transitions (Sangrands across all 12 Punjabi months from Chet through Phagun) and lunar tithi endpoints are computed with Sri Anandpur Sahib (India Standard Time, UTC+05:30) as the primary reference alongside the user's local device timezone.
- **Lunar Tithis**: Tracks daily Sudhi (waxing) and Vadhi (waning) tithis, including Puranmashi (full moon), Masya (new moon), Panchmi, Ashtami, and Ekadashi.

## Coverage (Sambat 2082–2084)
- **Full 3-Year Parity**: Complete coverage of Gurpurabs (Parkash, Gurgaddi, Joti Jot), Shaheedi Divases (including Shaheedi Hafta 6–13 Poh), Khalsa & Sampardai historical days, 15 Bhagats, 11 Bhatts, Gursikh Bani-kars, Guru Ghar families, Panj Pyare, Khalsa Shaheeds, and Sampardai Mahapurakh Barsis across Sambat 2082, 2083, and 2084.
- **Primary Scriptural Colophons**: Every observance links directly to primary Granth & Barah Maha readings on Tatkhalsa Pothi.

## Key Features
- Bilingual English and Punjabi (Gurmukhi) interface with Dual (`Both`) script mode and curated Parchment, Surmai Night, and Hazuri Kesri themes.
- Full 365/366-day and selective RFC 5545 `.ics` calendar export (1,096 total daily dates across Sambat 2082–2084).
- Personal Desi Date reminders (birthdays, anniversaries, family barsis) saved locally, included in `.ics` exports and A4 printable monthly Jantris.
- Offline-capable Progressive Web App (PWA).
